sections.title: Battle
sections.text: Send your line-up to battle in Campaign Mode and Auto-Battle. During the Campaign you can earn Player EXP Coins EXP Juice and other rewards.

sections.title: Tests
sections.text: Progress through each floor of the building to fight enemies with increasing difficulty. Rewards for clearing a floor may include Lunch Boxes Coins Gear and Girl Shards.

sections.title: League
sections.text: Challenge other players in the League to win rewards. Special rewards are also given based on rank at the end of a season.

sections.title: Capsules
sections.text: Opening Capsules is the fastest way to acquire new Girls. Opening Advanced Capsules will grant you Egg Energy which you can use to summon a 5-Star Girl.

sections.title: Graduate
sections.text: This is the only way to acquire 6-Star Girls. Choose a Girl to graduate; will keep her experience and Gear. Girls used to Graduate the chosen Girl will have their EXP Juice Lunch Boxes and Gear returned to you. The more Girls you acquire the more chances you have to Graduate Girls to higher Star Ranks.

sections.title: Transfer
sections.text: When you have Girls that you don't need you can Transfer them. Transferring a Girl will reward you with EXP Juice Lunch Boxes Crystal Chisels and Class Lists. Class Lists can be used in the Transfer Store to purchase high-level Girls. Class Lists can also be obtained through special events.

sections.title: Gear Forge
sections.text: Combine low-level Gear in the Gear Forge to acquire higher level Gear. Combine Gear from the same set and quality level to unlock special properties! Note: Equipped Gear cannot be forged.

sections.title: Slot Machines
sections.text: Use Slot Machine Tickets to win prizes like Girl Shards Coins Gear Antiques Crystal Chisels EXP Juice and more! Good luck!

sections.title: Market
sections.text: The Market sells EXP Juice Lunch Boxes Girl Shards Gear Capsule Coins League Tickets and other goods. Merchandise will be restocked every 24 hours.

sections.title: Enroll
sections.text: Use Enroll Seals to acquire 4 and 5-Star Girls and Girl Shards from specific factions. You will also receive Portfolios that you can use to exchange 4 and 5-Star Girls within the same faction.

sections.title: Intern
sections.text: New Intern quests will be available every 24 hours. Each quest is given a star ranking and will have requirements for the type and rank of the Girls needed to complete the quest. Completing each quest will earn you great rewards. You can spend Gems to refresh tasks that haven't been locked or started already. You can also spend Gems to speed up tasks that you've already started. Intern Scrolls can be used to add additional quests to your list. These scrolls are dropped as Loot in Auto-Battle and are also available at the Market.

sections.title: Servant
sections.text: Servants are the best partners to have in battle. If you add a Servant to your team they can provide auras to give your Girls attribute boosts and trigger unique active skills during battle. You may also collect Servant Cookies and Spirit Cookies to train and evolve your Servants.

sections.title: Overview
sections.text: The Campaign Map is divided into four difficulty levels: Normal Hard Nightmare and Fantasy. Each difficulty level has multiple stages which must be unlocked in order.

sections.title: Unlock Level
sections.text: When you reach a new level you must take time to explore the level first. Afterwards you will be allowed to deploy Girls for Battle.

sections.title: Unlock Area & Map
sections.text: Clear all the Stages in one Area to unlock the next Area. Clear all Areas to unlock the next difficulty level.

sections.title: Battle Rewards
sections.text: You will receive special rewards after winning each Battle.

sections.title: Auto-Battle
sections.text: You will receive Loot EXP and Coins while you are engaged in Auto-Battle for up to 12 hours. After that you will stop accumulating these rewards and must return to the Auto-Battle screen to collect your rewards.

sections.title: Auto-Battle Rewards
sections.text: You will receive player EXP Coins and EXP Juice. Rewards received from Auto-Battle are determined by the stage; the further you progress in the Campaign the more rewards you will get. Your VIP Level increases the output rate for EXP Juice Player EXP and Coins.

sections.title: Drops & Loot
sections.text: You can check the loot information for a specific stage by clicking on its button. When you are auto-battling in a stage you might obtain items that drop from that stage (this can be checked in loot).

sections.title: Battle Line-Up
sections.text: Girls positioned in the Front Row will take more attacks than Girls in the Back Row. Adjust the Girls' positions according to their Class so that the whole team survives longer.

sections.title: Faction Rivalry
sections.text: Girls from House Cosmos will not be affected by Faction Rivary. Faction Rivalry gives boosts to Girls when fighting against specific Factions. Deploy Girls based on the boosts they will gain from fighting against your opponent's Faction.

sections.title: Faction Aura
sections.text: Certain Faction combinations will give Aura boosts to all of your Girls in battle.

sections.title: Victory or Defeat
sections.text: Defeat all your opponents' Girls within 15 Rounds for a Victory. Failure to finish within 15 rounds or having all your Girls defeated will result in a Defeat.

sections.title: Attack
sections.text: Attack refers to the damage dealt to enemies. The higher Attack a Girl has the more damage she will deal in an attack.

sections.title: HP
sections.text: HP allows Girls to survive longer in Battle.

sections.title: Armor
sections.text: Armor helps to reduce damage from your opponents.

sections.title: Speed
sections.text: Speed determines the order that Girls attack in battle. Higher Speed allows Girls to attack first every round. If girls on the same team have equal Speed the girl closest to the first position in the front will move first.

sections.title: Extra Skill Damage
sections.text: Extra Skill Damage gives bonus damage to skill attacks boosts the damage rate that is based on the characters' Attack attribute in Active skills only.

sections.title: Block
sections.text: Block determines the probability of blocking an attack. Blocking an attack successfully will reduce 30% of the damage taken; if the attack was a critical strike blocking will reduce 50% of the damage taken. Only damage based on the Attack of the attacker will be reduced by blocking.

sections.title: Precision
sections.text: Precision lowers the probability of the target blocking an attack. Furthermore every 1% of Precision will grant an extra 0.3% of damage. The extra damage will max out at 45%. Only damage based on the Attack of the attacker will be increased.

sections.title: Crit Rate
sections.text: Crit Rate determines the probability of performing a critical strike against an opponent dealing significantly increased damage. Without extra Crit damage increases a Critical Strike will cause 150% damage of a normal attack. Passive skills will not trigger Crit attacks.

sections.title: Crit Resist
sections.text: Reduce the chance to take Critical hits the higher a girl's Crit Resist is the less likely she's going to take a Critical hit.

sections.title: Crit Damage
sections.text: Crit Damage determines how much extra damage is dealt when performing a critical strike. The highest Crit Damage that an attack can have is 150%.

sections.title: Armor Break
sections.text: Armor Break decreases your opponents' Armor allowing you to deal more damage to the opponent. The maximum amount of Armor Break that can be reached is 100%.

sections.title: Immunity
sections.text: Immunity helps against attacks that restrict your Girls like Petrify Freeze and Stun. Immunity is calculated differently from the control effect chances: for example an attack with a 50% chance to restrict a girl may be possible to control a girl with 70% Immunity.

sections.title: Control Rate
sections.text: Increases the rate the enemy will be affected by your control skills. This status will be calculated together with the target's Immunity.

sections.title: Damage Reduction
sections.text: Damage Reduction reduces the amount of damage inflicted by opponents helping your Girls to survive longer. It will max out at 70% and only works on damage based on the Attack of the attacker. (But cannot affect the damage caused by Healing Curse)

sections.title: Holy Damage
sections.text: Holy Damage will not be affected by the armor of the target but will be affected by Damage Reduction.

sections.title: Damage Depletion
sections.text: Reduces all damages received and is calculated separately from Damage Reduction. 70% Damage Depletion maximum is obtainable by a Girl.

sections.title: Dodge
sections.text: Provides Girls chance to avoid damages and effects from enemies' Active Skills and Basic Attacks.(Servant's Active skill cannot be dodged)

sections.title: Energy
sections.text: Every girl starts with 50 Energy when the battle begins. A girl will gain 50 Energy when she attacks the enemy and will gain 10 Energy when she is attacked. If she takes a Critical strike she will gain 20 Energy. A girl can only use her active skill when she has 100 or more Energy. When she has more than 100 Energy every extra Energy will be counted as 1% of Extra Skill Damage.

sections.title: Energy Removal Resist
sections.text: Decreases the number of Energy removed by enemy's skills based on the percentage of the attribute. For example if a skill removes 50 Energy with 20% Energy Removal Resist it will only remove 40 Energy.

sections.title: The color of DMG
sections.text: If it's white it means this attack doesn't trigger Crit attack and the attacker doesn't have Faction Rivalry buff. If it's yellow it means this attack doesn't trigger Crit attack and the attacker is buffed by Faction Rivalry. If it's red it means this attack is a Crit attack (the attack can be either buffed by Faction Rivalry or not). And if it's green it's showing the healing amount.

sections.title: Skill Effect
sections.text: Buffs or debuffs labeled with “Skill effect” cannot be removed by Potential or Skills.

sections.title: From Loot
sections.text: You can receive Girl Shards from Auto-Battle Campaign Stages Events Girl Quizzes and Tests.

sections.title: From Stores
sections.text: You can get Girls and Girl Shards at the Market Slot Machine Store and Transfer Store.

sections.title: From Capsules
sections.text: The most direct way to get Girls is by summoning with Hearts as well as using Capsule Coins and Gems for the machines on the Capsule screen.

sections.title: Enroll
sections.text: You can use Seals in the Enroll menu to get Girl Shards.

sections.title: Slots
sections.text: You can use Slot Machine Tickets to get Girl Shards.

sections.title: Internship Quests
sections.text: Some Internship Quests have Girl Shards as rewards.

sections.title: Friend Boss
sections.text: You can get some Girl Shards by defeating Friend Bosses

sections.title: Level-Up Girls
sections.text: Use EXP Juice to level up your Girls.

sections.title: Upgrade Girls
sections.text: Use Lunch Boxes to upgrade a Girl's Star Rank when they reach the level cap for their current Star rank.

sections.title: Graduate
sections.text: When a Girl reaches max level and Star Rank you can use Graduate to increase her Star rank. After Graduating she will have higher stats. Her level gear and other features will stay the same.

sections.title: Awake
sections.text: Use other Girls to Awake 6-Star Girls unlocking even higher max Star Ranks. Girls used to Awaken the chosen Girl will return some EXP Juice.

sections.title: Gear & Antiques
sections.text: Equip your Girls with Gear and Antiques to further strengthen your Girls' stats. Gear and Antiques can be upgraded to higher quality items.

sections.title: Crystal Upgrades
sections.text: Increase Girl stats by upgrading or exchanging the crystal they hold. These functions require Coins and Crystal Chisels.

sections.title: Elite Skills
sections.text: Girls at or above 10-star can upgrade their current skills to elite skills; the upgrade will cost you "Standard File" and "Exclusive File"

sections.title: Classes
sections.text: Girls can be classified according to their class: Warrior Mage Ranger Assassin and Priest. Warriors have high HP and Armor but their ATK tends to be lower. They are usually placed in the frontline to take damage. Mages and Rangers tend to have low HP and Armor but their ATK tends to be high and they often deal AoE damage. They usually fit in the backline dealing damage. Assassin class stats are similar to Mages and Rangers stats but their attacks often hit a single target so they tend to be placed in the backline. Priests tend to have lower stat than other classes but they often have crowd control abilities and HP regeneration making them great supports in the backline.

sections.title: Star Rank
sections.text: Each Girl has a starting Star Rank. 5-star is the highest starting rank. The higher the star rank a Girl has the higher her basic stats and skills will be. Graduating or Awakening a Girl helps raise her Star Rank.

sections.title: Faction
sections.text: Each Girl is part of one of the following factions: Cosmos Demon Angel Fairy Ghost Human or Monster. Certain factions counter each other in game: Fairy counters Ghost Ghost counters Human Human counters Monster Monster counters Fairy Demon and Angel counter each other. Girls deal 30% extra damage and have a 15% increase to Precision when fighting a faction that they counter. (Cosmos Girls won't be affected by Faction Rivalry)

sections.title: Gear/Antique Quality
sections.text: There are 7 levels of quality (Blue Gold Purple Green Red Orange and Pink) with Blue being the lowest and Pink being the highest.

sections.title: Gear/Antique Star Grades
sections.text: Blue and Gold-quality Gear can be upgraded to 2 stars Purple up to 3 stars Green and Red up to 4 stars Orange up to 6 stars and Pink up to 3 stars. Blue and Gold-quality Antiques can be upgraded to 4 stars Purple and Green up to 5 stars Red and Orange up to 6 stars and Pink up to 3 stars. The higher Star Grade a piece of Gear or an Antique has the more attribute bonuses it will provide.

sections.title: Gear Forge
sections.text: Low-quality Gear can be Forged to make higher-quality pieces of Gear. Antique Shards can be assembled to produce Antiques of the same quality.

sections.title: Acquiring Gear
sections.text: You can earn Gear through Auto-Battle Tests Campaign Loot and Slot Machines. They can also be purchased at the Market Guild Merchant Sanctuary Store and Slot Machine Store.

sections.title: Gear Sets
sections.text: Gear whose quality is 3-Star Green Gear or above have Set bonuses which are triggered when the required number of Gear in the same set is equipped to the same girl.

sections.title: Upgrade Antiques
sections.text: Tap an equipped Antique then tap the up arrow. From here you can combine Antiques from your Bag in order to upgrade your current Antique.

sections.title: Acquiring Antiques
sections.text: Once you reach a certain stage in Campaign you may receive Antique Shards as possible rewards from auto-battle. The Guild Merchant has Antique Shards for sale and the Slot Machines have Antiques as prizes.

sections.title: Finding Friends
sections.text: Search using their ID; Choose from Recommended Friends under the Search tab; Tap player avatar in Chat; Tap Guild member's avatar in Guild Office

sections.title: Friend Requests
sections.text: View your Friend requests under the Requests tab. Tap Agree to add a player as a friend.

sections.title: Hearts
sections.text: Friends can send Hearts to each other. Collect 10 Hearts to earn a BFF Capsule.

sections.title: Delete Friends
sections.text: Tap your friend's avatar in the List tab then tap the trash button in the friend's infobox.

sections.title: Help Fight
sections.text: You may challenge a Friend Boss every day. In this mode you will be able to borrow a girl from your Friends. If you defeat the boss you will be rewarded with Gems Coins Girls Shards etc. You will also be awarded according to how many times the girls you set on Duty has helped your friend to defeat Friend Bosses.

sections.title: Joining a Guild
sections.text: Enter Guild ID or Guild name to search for a Guild then tap "Apply" to send an application to the Guild. You can join after your request is approved.

sections.title: Creating a Guild
sections.text: You can create a Guild from the Guild interface. Creating a Guild costs Gems. After your Guild is created you can invite other players to your Guild and accept applications to grow your Guild.

sections.title: Guild Leader
sections.text: The Guild Leader has access to all functions in the Guild Office. The Leader can also transfer their position to other members.

sections.title: Disband Guild
sections.text: The Leader can disband the Guild by tapping the Disband button in the Office. After the Leader confirms the Guild will be disbanded after 2 hours.

sections.title: Guild Level
sections.text: Make sure all your members sign into the Office daily to increase your Guild Level.

sections.title: Guild Merchant
sections.text: Use Guild Coins at the Guild Merchant to purchase Girl Shards Gear and Antique Shards.

sections.title: Lab
sections.text: Use Guild Coins in the Lab to upgrade your Guild Skills. Guild Skills will strengthen your own Girls during Guild Battles. You retain Skill upgrades if you transfer to another Guild.

sections.title: Guild Functions
sections.text: All members of the Guild can sign into the Guild Office each day to increase the Guild Level. Members can participate in Gym Battles Cafeteria and Playground to get Guild Coins and other rewards.

sections.title: -Armor Buff\Debuff
sections.text: Increases or decreases a Girl's Armor. Increasing a Girl's armor could lower the damage she takes.

sections.title: -Attack Buff\Debuff
sections.text: Increases or decreases a Girl's Attack. Attack will affect the amount of damage a Girl deals.

sections.title: -Armor Break Buff\Debuff
sections.text: Increases or decreases a girl's Armor Break. Armor Break lowers the effectiveness of Armor.

sections.title: -Crit Chance Buff\Debuff
sections.text: A higher Crit will increase the chance for a Girl to deal critical damage.

sections.title: -Crit Damage Buff\Debuff
sections.text: Crit Damage affects the damage done by a girl's critical attack.

sections.title: -Damage Reduction Buff\Debuff
sections.text: Damage Reduction could lower the damage a Girl receives from an attack

sections.title: -Bleed
sections.text: Girls with "Bleed" status will take bleeding damage at the beginning of a round; The first "Bleed" damage will be dealt once after the attack.

sections.title: -Burn
sections.text: Girls with "Burn" status will take burning damage at the beginning of a round; The first "Burn" damage will be dealt once after the attack.

sections.title: -Poison
sections.text: Girls with "Poison" status will take poison damage at the beginning of a round; The first "Poison" damage will be dealt once after the attack.

sections.title: -Precision Boost\Debuff
sections.text: Attacks can be blocked. Increasing Precision lowers the chance of an attack being blocked and grants extra damage.

sections.title: -Block Boost\Debuff
sections.text: Increasing Block improves the chances for a Girl to block attacks lowering damage taken.

sections.title: -Skill Damage Boost\Debuff
sections.text: Skill Damage will affect the damage of a Girl's active skill but it will not affect the damage of DoT damage.

sections.title: -Speed Boost\Debuff
sections.text: Speed will affect a round's move order. Girls with higher speed can move earlier in a round.

sections.title: -Holy Damage Buff\Debuff
sections.text: Holy Damage will be calculated into a Girl's attacks. It ignores the effects of armor and can crit if the attack is a critical strike.

sections.title: -Weaken
sections.text: Girls with "Weaken" status will take 50% extra damage. This status cannot be stacked.

sections.title: -HP Regeneration
sections.text: Girls with "HP Regeneration" status will regenerate her HP at the beginning of a round.

sections.title: -Heal Reduction
sections.text: The effectiveness of Healing skill will be lowered on the Girls with this status.

sections.title: -Pursue(Ithil)
sections.text: Girl's with "Pursue" status will consume this status when she triggers her active skill each stack of "Pursue" status will deal damage to the enemy with the lowest Hp and Bleed her.

sections.title: -Bringers of Fate (Esau & Jacob)
sections.text: The targets will take damage once the mark is tagged. And they will take the same amount of damage again at the beginning of the next round.

sections.title: -Dauntless(Rogue)
sections.text: Allows Rogue to remove 1 stack of this status to reflect part of the damage she takes back to the attacker.

sections.title: -Disrespect(Rogue)
sections.text: Allows Rogue to remove 1 stack of this status to Immune from 1 Control skill

sections.title: -Galaxy(Vivian)
sections.text: When Vivian takes damage or Debuff the enemy Vivian tags Galaxy on will also take part of the damage or take the same debuff

sections.title: -Remnant(Joan)
sections.text: Joan can gain additional Damage Reduction from each stack of Remnant she has

sections.title: -Lily Shield(Izanami)
sections.text: The shield will convert next damage from Basic Attack or Active skill into healing

sections.title: -Healing Curse(Izanami)
sections.text: Will convert the next Healing the target receives into Damage(The healing dealt by Servants will not be affected by Healing Curse)

sections.title: -Disintegration(Trinity)
sections.text: The enemy under Disintegration will take more Damage Over Time than usual

sections.title: -Volos(Apate)
sections.text: Volos will deal damage to the enemy with the lowest HP. (the damage will be calculated according to the target's lost HP)

sections.title: -Anoxia(Skye)
sections.text: Each stack of Anoxia will reduce the target's Speed can stack maximum 5 times on a single target.

sections.title: -Lullaby(Vera)
sections.text: Girl with this effect will be able to deal damage that ignores armor to the attacker and heal herself (based on the Girl's Attack) when taking damage from an Active Skill or Basic Attack.

sections.title: -Hunter's Mark (Von Helsing)
sections.text: When the mark carrier is attacked by Von Helsing (has to be the one who stacks the mark on the target) each Hunter's Mark stacked will increase the Attack damage and Crit Damage dealt; If the mark carrier is defeated the Girl with the highest Attack attribute in the mark carrier's team will take damage.

sections.title: -Blood Thirst (Von Helsing)
sections.text: When Von Helsing releases an Active skill the Blood Thirst stacks on her will be released to deal damage and restore an equal amount of HP to her.

sections.title: -Moon Dust (Blair)
sections.text: When Blair deals Active skill or Basic Attack she (has to be the one who stacks Moon Dust on the target) will additionally deal the same attack once to enemies stacked with Moon Dust and heal herself according to the damage dealt.

sections.title: -Parasite (Holly)
sections.text: Reduces Attack and Healing Received of the enemies inflicted with Parasite can be stacked 3 times max.

sections.title: -Natural Order (Holly)
sections.text: When enemies release their Active Skills deal Basic Attack or trigger their Passive Skills that affect the opponents they will compulsively target Holly (with Natural Order); if the attacker is inflicted with Parasite heals Holly (with Natural Order) according to her maximum HP.

sections.title: -Righteous Might (Teresa)
sections.text: Used to trigger Teresa's Passive skill: "Righteous Protection".

sections.title: -Sun Slayer (Angelica)
sections.text: Angelica will Hunt the enemy with the lowest HP percentage the same number of times as the stacks of Sun Slayer that she has when she triggers Active Skills and Basic Attacks.

sections.title: -Dark Star Mark (Frexie)
sections.text: Detonates at the end of the round dealing damage according to the damage the mark carrier takes in the round. If the target is already tagged with a Dark Star Mark when a second one is tagged deals damage according to the target's maximum HP.

sections.title: -Blood Prison (Frexie)
sections.text: Reduces the carrier's Armor Damage Reduction Damage Depletion Block and chance to Dodge cannot be stacked.

sections.title: -Blood Ring (Frexie)
sections.text: Increases the carrier's chance of Dodging enemies' Active Skills and Basic Attacks.

sections.title: -Cat Eyes(Kassy)
sections.text: When the owner of Cat Eyes releases an Active Skill or deals a Basic Attack deals extra damage according to the target's total lost HP and heals the owner according to the damage dealt.

sections.title: -Future Observation (Monica)
sections.text: Consumed to trigger Monica's passive skill "Rewind".

sections.title: -Wheel of Fate (Monica)
sections.text: Resets the trigger limit of "Rewind" of the owner of this effect grants the owner Attack and Extra Control Rate boosts and heals the owner when Monica is healed.

sections.title: -Laws of Time (Monica)
sections.text: Reduces Heal Received and Control Immunity

sections.title: -Nightmare (Diana)
sections.text: Deals damage to the owner at the end of each Round. When the owner is defeated deals damage to all enemies.

sections.title: -Aether Leakage (Sivney)
sections.text: Increases direct damage taken.

sections.title: -Aether Exhaustion (Sivney)
sections.text: Increases direct damage taken and reduces Heal Received.

sections.title: -Gilded Butterflies (Gwen & Brigit)
sections.text: Increases chance for the owner to take Critical Strikes from the Gwen & Brigit who afflicted this effect and Crit Damage of the Critical Strikes dealt by the aforementioned Gwen & Brigit. When the Gwen & Brigit who afflicted this effect is attacked by the owner of this effect her Frontline allies will help take some damage for her and split damage taken between themselves.

sections.title: -Chaos Scar (Maia)
sections.text: Every stack of this effect lowers the Maximum HP and Heal Received of the owner. Maximum HP lowered by this effect cannot be recovered through healing effects.

sections.title: -Malediction (Maia)
sections.text: This Mark will be triggered when the owner gains an Attribute Increase Buff. Every stack of Malediction will remove 1 stack of Attribute Increase Buff and deal damage based on Maia’s Attack to the owner and the stacks will be removed after being triggered.

sections.title: -Grievous Wound (Antique - Soul Destruction)
sections.text: Reduce the target's Healing Received and Damage Depletion.

sections.title: -Premonition (Antique - Reaper's Voice)
sections.text: Reduce the target's Speed.

sections.title: -Blessings of Snow (Antique - Snow Chime)
sections.text: Increases the target's Heal Received Damage Depletion and Energy when attacked.

sections.title: -Magick Barrier
sections.text: Nullifies all incoming damage for the owner. The Magick Barrier's durability depends on how many Barrier Points (BP) it has: 1 BP nullifies 1 damage. When the Magick Barrier's BP reaches 0 it will shatter and disappear. A Magick Barrier can have up to (100% of owner's maximum HP) BP.

sections.title: -Sanguine Snare (Lord Dracula)
sections.text: Girls with "Sanguine Snare" will take damage according to their maximum HP at the end of each round. The same amount of damage will also be dealt when the effect is inflicted.

sections.title: -Blood Bats (Lord Dracula)
sections.text: Used to boost the damage of Sanguine Snare.

sections.title: -Matric Reinforcement(Cygmar)
sections.text: Grants the owner additional Control Immunity and Precision.

sections.title: -Cubic Stronghold(Cygmar)
sections.text: grants additional [c][e28002]Magick Barrier[-][/c] according to the healing received.

sections.title: -Zephyr's Blessing(Windbringer)
sections.text: Recovers HP and gains a Magick Barrier with BP equivalent to the amount of HP healed at the end of every round. When nullifying damage the Magick Barrier loses less BP.

sections.title: -Scar of Belinus(Uriel)
sections.text: When 2 Scars of Belinus are stacked Trial of Belinus will be triggered for 2 rounds and remove Scars of Belinus stacked.

sections.title: -Trial of Belinus(Uriel)
sections.text: A Control effect. Stops the targets from triggering their Passive skill. When this effect is removed or expires the owner will take damage (no more than 1500% of Uriel's Attack).

sections.title: -Resonant Mark(Apate)
sections.text: Targets stacked with Resonant Mark will trigger it when their Energy reaches more than 100. Damage will be dealt according to owner's current Energy and the Energy will be removed (the mark will be removed once triggered).

sections.title: -Crane's Plume(Chizuko)
sections.text: Increases all damage the owner of this Skill Effect takes by and lowers the owner’s Attack.When the owner is healed the ally of the caster of this Skill Effect that has the lowest HP will recover HP equivalent to the amount that is healed and the ally of the owner that has the lowest HP will take damage equivalent to the amount that is healed. This effect can only be triggered for at most 10 times in a round.

sections.title: -Luminosity(Chizuko)
sections.text: nThe owner of this Skill Effect becomes immune to the next 2 instances of damage dealt to her. This Skill Effect will disappear after the owner takes damage twice. If this Skill Effect is cast on a Girl who already has this Skill Effect it will be reset to its default state. When this Skill Effect disappears or is reset the owner of this Skill Effect gains a Magick Barrier with (damage that this Skill Effect immuned) BP.

sections.title: -Headwinds(K.M. Enlightened)
sections.text: This Mark triggers when the owner of this Mark takes damage from Basic Attacks or Active Skills. When triggered it deals damage to the owner and has a chance to Stun the owner. This Mark disappears after it is triggered.

sections.title: -Tailwinds(K.M. Enlightened)
sections.text: All damage dealt by the owner of this Effect increases according to the owner's Attack Attribute.

sections.title: -Liquid Poison
sections.text: Deals damage based on the owner's Maximum HP to the owner of this effect when afflicted and at the end of each Round in the duration of this effect. If damage dealt is lower than 50% of the caster's Attack then this effect will deal damage equivalent to 50% of the caster's Attack.

sections.title: -Suffocate
sections.text: The owner of this Skill Effect will have its Heal Received lowered by 50% Energy gain lowered by 50% and take 100% more damage from Damage Over Time effects.

sections.title: -Miasma(Syrcotte)
sections.text: The owner of this Effect will deal less damage to the caster of this Effect and will take damage at the end of each round.

sections.title: -Starburst(Syrcotte)
sections.text: Increases the owner’s Attack Crit and Precision. The owner of this Effect will Dodge damage and effects of enemies' Attacks and Skills that target random enemies.

sections.title: -Star's Whisper(Nebula Slasher)
sections.text: Increases Attack Precision and Holy Damage.

sections.title: -Locked On(Von Helsing)
sections.text: Von Helsing’s Basic Attack and Active skill will take priority in selecting a target to lock on to.

sections.title: -Hounded(Eve)
sections.text: Used to strengthen Eve’s Active Skill

sections.title: -Canine Protection(Eve)
sections.text: When the Magick Barrier protecting the owner of this Effect disappears this Effect will be triggered and heal the owner. This Effect will disappear after triggered.

sections.title: -Heartbeat(Cupid)
sections.text: Grants all allies a Magick Barrier when removed

sections.title: -Heartfelt(Cupid)
sections.text: When the owner of this Effect receives a heal effect if the amount of HP healed will cause the owner's current HP to surpass her maximum HP the surplus healing will be transformed into the BP of a Magick Barrier. If the owner is protected by a Magick Barrier increase the owner's Damage Depletion Attack and the final damage she deals.

sections.title: -Starflare(Promethea)
sections.text: Whenever the owner of this Effect takes damage damage taken will be reduced and this effect will reflect a portion of damage taken to the attacker. (Fixed damage that will neither Crit nor be affected by attributes or effects that increase or reduce damage to the target cannot be reduced or reflected)

sections.title: -Hellfire(Promethea)
sections.text: The owner of this Effect will have their Heal Received and Block reduced and gain less Energy.

sections.title: -Chains of Woe(Torch of Despair)
sections.text: When the owner of this Effect takes lethal damage and triggers any effect that prevents them from being defeated by this lethal damage only 1 HP will remain on them.

sections.title: -Untainted(Nymphaea)
sections.text: The owner of this Effect recovers HP based on their lost HP and gains Attack when they take damage from Active Skills and Basic Attack of targets afflicted with Bleed.

sections.title: -Full Bloom(Nymphaea)
sections.text: The owner of this Effect will take extra damage based on their Maximum HP when Bleed is inflicted to them.

sections.title: -Primal Red(Elysia)
sections.text: The owner of this Effect will have their Speed reduced

sections.title: -Primal Yellow(Elysia)
sections.text: The owner of this Effect will have their Armor reduced.

sections.title: -Primal Blue(Elysia)
sections.text: The owner of this Effect will have their Attack reduced.

sections.title: -Hybrid Orange(Elysia)
sections.text: Increases all damage taken by the owner of this Effect.

sections.title: -Hybrid Purple(Elysia)
sections.text: Reduces Heal Received and Barrier Points granted to the owner of this Effect.

sections.title: -Hybrid Green(Elysia)
sections.text: Reduces all damage dealt by the owner of this Effect.

sections.title: The owner of this effect cannot release Active Skills deal Basic Attacks Hunt or Counterattack nor can they recover HP regenerate Energy replenish Barrier Points or gain new Magick Barriers. All damage taken by them will also be increased.
-Pisces' Gift(Elysia)
sections.text: Increases the owner’s Extra Control Rate by 10% and Crit Damage Mitigation by 20%.

sections.title: -Dragon's Curse(Raenvya)
sections.text: Reduces the Crit and Block of the owner of this Effect.

sections.title: -Dragon's Favor(Raenvya)
sections.text: The caster of this Effect will take some damage for the owner of this Effect.

sections.title: -Dragon Soul(Raenvya)
sections.text: Raenvya's Soul resides within the owner of this Effect.

sections.title: -Peacock Feather(Azucena)
sections.text: The owner of this Effect deals less damage to the caster of this Effect. When the owner deals damage to the caster the caster will absorb and transform a portion of damage dealt into a Magick Barrier with the equivalent amount of BP.

sections.title: -Mesmerize(Azucena)
sections.text: The owner receives more damage from Damage Over Time effects and takes damage both when this Effect is inflicted and at the start of the round.

faq.title: Câu Hỏi Chung
lines: 1. Hỏi: Làm sao để tiếp tục chơi trên thiết bị khác?
Đáp: Đăng nhập bằng đúng tài khoản đã liên kết và chọn đúng máy chủ. Không dùng bản lưu khách để chuyển dữ liệu giữa thiết bị.
2. Hỏi: Quên mật khẩu hoặc mất quyền đăng nhập thì làm sao?
Đáp: Sử dụng tính năng khôi phục tài khoản của GXB 3; nếu không thành công, liên hệ QTV và cung cấp UID. Không gửi mật khẩu hay mã xác thực.
3. Hỏi: Không thể kết nối do hết thời gian chờ?
Đáp: Kiểm tra kết nối mạng và tải lại game. Nếu máy chủ đang khởi động, vui lòng thử lại sau.
4. Hỏi: Game không tải được tài nguyên hoặc bản cập nhật?
Đáp: Tải lại trang bằng Ctrl+Shift+R trên PC hoặc làm mới trình duyệt trên điện thoại. Không xóa dữ liệu trang khi chưa biết tình trạng tài khoản.
5. Hỏi: Không thấy nhân vật hoặc tiến độ chơi?
Đáp: Kiểm tra tài khoản và máy chủ đang đăng nhập. Nếu vẫn thiếu dữ liệu, liên hệ QTV kèm UID và thông tin sự cố.
6. Hỏi: Game liên tục bị mất kết nối?
Đáp: Thử một mạng khác và kiểm tra trạng thái máy chủ. Không tạo tài khoản mới để thay thế nếu tài khoản cũ vẫn tồn tại.
7. Hỏi: Trò chơi bị treo hoặc tự đóng?
Đáp: Làm mới game và ghi lại thao tác gây lỗi, trình duyệt, thiết bị. Gửi cho QTV nếu lỗi lặp lại.
8. Hỏi: Phát hiện người chơi gian lận?
Đáp: Lưu bằng chứng, UID và thời gian sự việc để báo QTV kiểm tra theo nhật ký máy chủ.

faq.title: Câu Hỏi Cộng Đồng
lines: 1. Hỏi: Làm sao xử lý tin nhắn quấy rối?
Đáp: Tránh chia sẻ thông tin riêng tư và báo QTV kèm UID, bằng chứng. Chỉ sử dụng tính năng chặn nếu giao diện hiện hỗ trợ.
2. Hỏi: Báo cáo quảng cáo hoặc lừa đảo ở đâu?
Đáp: Ghi lại nội dung và UID của tài khoản liên quan, sau đó gửi cho QTV để kiểm tra.
3. Hỏi: Có thể kết bạn với người chơi thật không?
Đáp: Chỉ những tương tác được máy chủ xác nhận mới là kết bạn thật. Danh sách gợi ý từ dữ liệu ngoại tuyến không phải lời mời bạn bè.
4. Hỏi: Những hoạt động nào đã hỗ trợ giữa bạn bè?
Đáp: Tùy chức năng đang được máy chủ mở. Không coi danh sách liên hệ nội bộ hay bản nháp là tin nhắn hoặc lượt tương tác thật.
5. Hỏi: Làm sao gia nhập Bang Hội?
Đáp: Vào Bang Hội, chọn Bang Hội có thật trên máy chủ rồi gửi đơn xin gia nhập. Bang Chủ hoặc Phó Bang có thể duyệt đơn.
6. Hỏi: Sau khi vào Bang Hội tôi có thể làm gì?
Đáp: Xem thành viên, đọc thông báo, trò chuyện và tham gia các hoạt động Bang Hội đã được máy chủ hỗ trợ.
7. Hỏi: Xu Bang Hội được sử dụng thế nào?
Đáp: Chỉ sử dụng tại các hệ thống Bang Hội thật đã được kết nối. Không có phần thưởng từ thành viên NPC hoặc bang hội mô phỏng.
8. Hỏi: Nâng kỹ năng Bang Hội để làm gì?
Đáp: Kỹ năng Bang Hội tăng thuộc tính khi hệ thống tương ứng được mở và tính toán ở máy chủ.

faq.title: Thanh Toán Và VIP
lines: 1. Hỏi: Làm cách nào tăng cấp VIP?
Đáp: Cấp VIP và quyền lợi được tính theo dữ liệu tài khoản trên máy chủ. Xem cấp hiện tại và cách tích lũy EXP VIP trong Hồ Sơ.
2. Hỏi: Có tự động nhân đôi Kim Cương lần nạp đầu không?
Đáp: Không mặc định. Chỉ nhận đúng vật phẩm và ưu đãi ghi trong gói nạp mà máy chủ công bố và QTV xác nhận.
3. Hỏi: Đã thanh toán nhưng chưa nhận vật phẩm thì làm gì?
Đáp: Giữ mã đơn, kiểm tra Hòm Thư của đúng UID và máy chủ, rồi liên hệ QTV qua kênh thanh toán đã công bố để đối soát. Không gửi mật khẩu hoặc OTP.
4. Hỏi: Vì sao số tiền chuyển khoản khác giá gói?
Đáp: Chỉ thanh toán theo số tiền và phương thức QTV xác nhận cho đúng mã đơn. Không chuyển tiền dựa trên tỷ giá hay bảng giá lưu từ phiên bản cũ.

faq.title: Liên Hệ Hỗ Trợ
lines: Nếu gặp sự cố, hãy sử dụng kênh hỗ trợ hoặc liên hệ QTV được công bố trực tiếp trong GXB 3.
Khi gửi yêu cầu: cung cấp UID, tên nhân vật, máy chủ và ảnh chụp lỗi nếu có.
Không gửi mật khẩu, mã khôi phục tài khoản, OTP hoặc thông tin thanh toán nhạy cảm.
